eric (support): Hey team — new customer NovaLabs hitting 403 on first requests after onboarding. Console shows an API key but it's in project `infra-temp-001` (internal) not the customer's project. Can someone check? :thinking:

maria (onboarding): Hmm, I triggered the normal OIDC flow for nova@novalabs.com earlier today. Provisioner confirmed a key was created but I didn't check project mapping.

provisioner-bot: Provisioner event: created api_key id=ak_8d7f3f project=infra-temp-001 label=svc:auto-provision owner=nova@novalabs.com

nora (provisioning): @maria any chance the onboarding webhook used a fallback mapping? We had one earlier when the org slug parsing failed.

maria (onboarding): I saw the webhook response 200 from the provisioner. Payload 
```
{ "org_slug": "novalabs", "desired_project": "proj-novalabs-42", "user": "nova@novalabs.com" }
```
But provisioner-bot shows project infra-temp-001.

eric (support): Customer logs: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-xxxx" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/generate 
# -> 403 {"error":"access_denied","message":"API key not bound to requested project"}
```
Customer says they only see one key in their console and it's not returned in API list.

sam (infra): tagging in. This smells like the temporary provisioning pool used when the project claim step timed out. We have a known path where if claim fails we create a key in the fallback project to avoid blocking. Usually reconciler moves it.

eric (support): Can we confirm if reconciler ran? What do we need to do to fix live for customer?

provisioner-bot: Reconciler job status: last_run=3129876100 result=partial_fail details="claim-not-observed: 1 key(s) in infra-temp-001"

nora (provisioning): Okay that's the issue. The key is orphaned in fallback. We can either move the key record to proj-novalabs-42 or reprovision a new key and delete the orphan. Which is safer?

sam (infra): Moving DB records is fastest but we must ensure audit trail and avoid key rotation for the customer. I recommend manual reassign + force sync so customer doesn't need to update their config. Steps: 1) verify key fingerprint with customer 2) update key.project_id -> proj-novalabs-42 3) run access sync 4) confirm customer API calls work.

maria (onboarding): I can reach out to NovaLabs for the fingerprint. Quick question: will billing attributes be preserved if we reassign?

sam (infra): Yes billing tags are separate; reassigning project_id in the keys table keeps tags unless someone overwrites. We'll snapshot current record first.

eric (support): Customer confirmed fingerprint matches ak_8d7f3f and gave permission to reassign. Please proceed, priority P1 for onboarding.

devops (infra): Performing snapshot and manual reassign now. Command: 
```
-- snapshot
INSERT INTO key_audits SELECT * FROM api_keys WHERE id='ak_8d7f3f';
-- reassign
UPDATE api_keys SET project_id='proj-novalabs-42', updated_by='infra_manual_fix', updated_at=NOW() WHERE id='ak_8d7f3f';
-- trigger sync
SELECT reconcile_key('ak_8d7f3f');
```

provisioner-bot: reconcile_key started for ak_8d7f3f at 3129876432 status=running

sam (infra): Confirming logs show the key now bound to proj-novalabs-42. Running a quick test call with the key to validate.

provisioner-bot: reconcile_key finished at 3129876600 result=success access_sync=ok

eric (support): NovaLabs now reports success! They can see the key in their console and initial requests are returning 200. :tada:

maria (onboarding): Filing a follow-up bug: provisioner should not create fallback keys without an immediate reconciler trigger; add alert when fallback use >0.

sam (infra): I'll add a reconciler re-run on provisioning completion and an alert for orphaned keys in fallback. Ticketing: INF-4592.

eric (support): Great. Leaving notes on the customer's support ticket and marking as solved. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:

nora (provisioning): Post-mortem notes: root cause - claim webhook laged out due to transient DB lock; fallback behavior created key in infra-temp-001; reconciler partial fail because of a worker timeout. Remediation: increase reconciler retry, add immediate sync hook, and instrument fallback metrics.

eric (support): Adding the customer-facing explanation: "We found the API key was provisioned into an internal fallback project due to a transient timing issue; we've reassigned it to your project and you should be able to call the API without changing your integration."

maria (onboarding): Sending the customer the short summary and confirming closure.

provisioner-bot: incident-tag: onboarding-orphaned-key-3129876543 closed
